milestone.name: 产品可用性与开源首次成功
milestone.goal: 让本人和不了解内部实现的新用户通过一个本地优先 Workbench 持续完成核心研究任务，并在清洁环境中完成首次带引用查询。

w4_transition.candidate_result: improved 1/3 frozen cases against a required minimum of 2/3
w4_transition.unmet_personal_use_debt: Five real task units across two existing families and one user-confirmed use remain a W5 release prerequisite.

stage_claim.claim: A single FastAPI application, SQLite authority, one Worker and a minimal same-origin Workbench can provide a recoverable cited-answer path and a clean-environment first success without a second service or frontend build toolchain.
falsifiers: The first query still requires understanding Runtime, Step, Artifact or internal database concepts.
Refresh, SSE disconnect, cancellation, failure or service restart loses authoritative Run state or recovery actions.
A final Citation cannot resolve to Evidence and SourceSnapshot lineage.
Fresh clone to cited answer exceeds 10 minutes after Provider wait time is separated.
The default install requires Node.js, LangGraph, Phoenix, Ragas, DeepEval or an external Trace service.
Mechanism tests pass while real user task completion, answer usability or recovery experience fails.

selected_architecture.web_assets: packaged HTML, CSS and ES modules served same-origin without CDN or Node.js
rejected_alternatives: React/Vite for the first release because it adds a Node.js build and release chain before a second UI consumer exists.
Streamlit, Gradio or a second frontend service because they create a second service/state boundary and weaken the frozen recovery contract.

required_capabilities: view user-language Run progress and compact budget state
cancel before later external calls start
read answer text with numeric Citations
open registered Evidence and SourceSnapshot locators
read limitations, unmet criteria and recovery actions

invariants: POST persists or returns one idempotent Task/Run and does not execute the whole workflow in the request thread.
SSE is a projection of SQLite run_events and event_id is the reconnect cursor.
The Run snapshot, not the last browser event, is terminal-state authority.
Resume accepts only an explicit recovery decision already admitted by Runtime policy.
An unknown paid external result is never automatically replayed.
Artifact and Evidence reads accept only registered identifiers, never arbitrary filesystem paths.
Errors do not expose API keys, raw Provider responses or local absolute paths.

dependency_contract.planned_dependency_decision: FastAPI and Uvicorn require an accepted ADR and lock diff at W5.1 before use.

offline_smoke_contract.required_path: install -> API -> Run -> Delivery -> Citation -> Workbench read
offline_smoke_contract.capability_claim: installation and local mechanism validation only; not live research capability

acceptance_points.name: 应用查询与 API 合同
个人持续使用与发布裁决

allowed_after_explicit_w5_1_entry: docs/decisions/* for the accepted FastAPI/Uvicorn dependency decision
pyproject.toml and uv.lock for the accepted minimal HTTP dependencies
prohibited_until_later_acceptance_points: ASGI server startup or background Worker loop
offline smoke corpus and fixture mode
public network, Provider or paid calls

out_of_scope: Revising or re-enabling the rejected W4 bounded Planner.
A second durable vertical slice, full-text paper verification or cross-database review.
React, Vite, Node.js, Streamlit, Gradio, Electron or a second service.
Multiple Workers, message queues, distributed databases, object storage or orchestration.
Experiment management, evaluation dashboards, Trace UI or evaluator configuration pages.
Memory, Skills, MCP, multi-Agent, plugin marketplace or multi-tenancy.
Automatic retry, fallback, constraint relaxation or replay of unknown paid calls.
stop_conditions: Workbench requires changing Evidence, Budget, Lease/Fencing or unknown-effect authority.
One-command startup requires a second scheduler, service, Worker pool or Node build environment.
First success requires writing a Secret to Git, SQLite, URL, browser storage or Artifact.
UI state cannot be reconstructed from SQLite after refresh or service restart.
The ten-minute goal can be met only by weakening Citation closure, error retention or real installation.
W5 requires migration of a second vertical slice and thereby changes the frozen goal or acceptance.
next_acceptance_point_at_freeze: W5.1 应用查询与 API 合同；必须由用户明确进入后才允许修改依赖或产品代码
